metadata.listing_duplicate_note: Three listing URL forms fetched; the index.php page-1 URL duplicates the supplied /laptop URL. There are two unique pagination pages, not three.
metadata.scope: All 23 unique laptop PDPs linked by the main product grid across both pagination pages of the supplied URL, retaining fq=1. Unrelated recommendation/sidebar products were excluded.
metadata.alias_policy: observed_aliases are exact site label/field phrases; observed_keywords are exact site descriptive tokens. additional_aliases are explicit normalization/search synonyms added for usability, not claims about site wording. value_keywords are observed examples, not field aliases or a complete catalogue of numeric values.
metadata.validation: All observed_aliases, observed_keywords, value_keywords, and evidence quotes were checked against the saved PDP corpus with whitespace normalization. Evidence URLs and product IDs are included per spec.
source_cautions: This is a vocabulary dictionary, not a hardware-truth database. Site inconsistencies and configuration-dependent claims are preserved.
PDP 11 and 12 part numbers in the description differ from their displayed MPNs.
Several model/title descriptions disagree (including TUF F15/A16 wording and AORUS AM6H/BZH identity). Do not silently reconcile them.
Warranty, fingerprints, IR cameras, bundled subscriptions and accessories can be conditional or region-dependent; absence of a label does not prove absence of a feature.
No aliases were imported from the earlier Compumarts crawl.
